articles.title: Kanté and Mavropanos rescue late point for West Ham in derby thriller at Millwall
articles.summary: West Ham came from two goals down to snatch a draw from a heated London derby at Millwall. The Lions were leading at half-time through goals from Caleb Taylor and Camiel Neghli, but the visitors hit back through Mohamadou Kanté and Konstantinos Mavropanos.
body: The Hammers, sitting top of the Championship and looking for a fifth straight win, finished their first meeting with their fierce rivals since 2012 with 10 men after Kanté saw red.

The Metropolitan Police had 400 officers on hand, having thrown a ring of steel around part of London to ensure there was no repeat of the violence that has marred this fixture in previous seasons. There were no immediate reports of any trouble, while West Ham showed no appetite for a fight on the pitch in a timid first half.

It took 15 seconds for Jenson Metcalfe to set the tone, going in hard on the West Ham captain, Jarrod Bowen. In years gone by a Mark Noble, a Julian Dicks or a Billy Bonds would have reciprocated, but West Ham did not put a tackle in throughout the first half.

Stoke staged a fine comeback to stun Sheffield United with a 2-1 win at the Bet365 Stadium despite Kalvin Phillips's first league goal for five and a half years. Two goals in the space of 11 second-half minutes from Jack McGlynn and Sam Gallagher (pictured) enabled the home wide to make it four wins in their past five Championship fixtures.

articles.title: Aston Villa grab victory despite late Spurs goals as De Zerbi’s side are booed off
articles.summary: Spurs have a remarkable ability to find new ways of inflicting pain on their fanbase and they did it again on Saturday, petering out from a strong start into humiliating defeat. On the upside, they did get two goals. They were both late consolations, but beggars can’t be choosers.
body: Aston Villa were ruthless after capitalising in first-half added time to take the lead while Spurs were temporarily down to 10 men. In the second half, they were robust in defence and clinical on the counter, with supreme strikes from Nicolas Jackson and Emi Buendía. With Johan Manzambi the other goalscorer, these were pleasing signs for Unai Emery’s turbo-charged refit of his team.

Zion Suzuki was probably the man of the match and certainly the star of the opening half-hour after he made a series of saves to deny Spurs the goal they so clearly desired. The highlight perhaps was a double save from Sávio in the 11th minute, but he also denied Archie Gray with his heel quite spectacularly.

All these saves added up to frustration in the ground and they began to affect the tone of the match. Spurs’ supporters were getting a sense that it might be (another) one of those days and Villa’s players began to relax a little knowing they had a barrier behind them. With direct passes to Jackson regularly troubling the Spurs defence, a chance would surely fall their way.
points: Spurs have a remarkable ability to find new ways of inflicting pain on their fanbase and they did it again on Saturday, petering out from a strong start into humiliating defeat.
They were both late consolations, but beggars can’t be choosers.

articles.title: Gerrit Cole makes MLB history for pitchers drafted 1st overall
articles.summary: Gerrit Cole has officially added another remarkable accomplishment to his already decorated MLB career. The New York Yankees ace picked up his 162nd career victory Friday night, passing Mike Moore for the most wins ever by a pitcher selected first overall in the MLB Draft.
body: It is another milestone in what has been a long journey for Cole, who was drafted by the Pittsburgh Pirates, traded to the Houston Astros, and eventually signed with the Yankees.

Cole reached the milestone during the Yankees’ 9-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, pitching six strong innings while allowing two runs on four hits with six strikeouts. The win moved him to 162 for his career, one ahead of Moore’s 161. David Price ranks third on the list with 157 victories after being selected first overall by Tampa Bay in 2007.

It is a fitting achievement for Cole, who entered professional baseball with enormous expectations after Pittsburgh selected him first overall in 2011 out of UCLA. MLB’s official player bio confirms Cole was the Pirates’ No. 1 pick that year.

Cole’s path to the record has taken him through three different organizations. The Pirates developed him into a frontline starter before trading him to Houston in January 2018. With the Astros, Cole elevated his game to another level, earning two All-Star selections and finishing second in AL Cy Young voting in 2019.

articles.title: Postponement not an option as Kenya races to be ready for Afcon 2027
articles.summary: African football boss Patrice Motsepe wants a "heightened sense of urgency" from Afcon 2027 co-hosts Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda as they face a race to be ready.
body: African football boss Patrice Motsepe has called for a "heightened sense of urgency" from next year's Africa Cup of Nations co-hosts Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda.
The tournament is set to return to East Africa for the first time in 51 years, with the opening match kicking off on 19 June and the final scheduled for 17 July.
Stadiums are supposed to be ready for testing in around three months' time, and Confederation of African Football (Caf) president Motsepe says there is little room for delay.

"Even though we've got nine months, we need to start using those stadiums in January next year to test them and to see what further improvements are required," he told BBC Sport Africa after inspecting preparations in Kenya on Friday.

articles.title: 'Fragile' Tottenham beaten by Aston Villa despite late rally
articles.summary: The end to Tottenham's Premier League goal drought came too late as Aston Villa won 3-2 in north London on Saturday to compound a miserable start for Roberto De Zerbi's men.
body: Without a league win this season, Tottenham are off to their worst start in the Premier League era and only netted their first goals of the campaign after the visitors had surged into a 3-0 lead.
Villa had also struggled for goals themselves since the side that won the Europa League last season was torn apart during the transfer window.
But new signings Johan Manzambi and Nicolas Jackson struck either side of half-time before Emi Buendia 's wonder strike to give Unai Emery's new-look team their first league win.
"Competing like we did, winning like we did will give us confidence collectively and individually, it is really very important," said Emery.

articles.summary: Nabati won the Dubai Duty Free Mill Reef Stakes (In Honour Of Ian Balding) for Charlie Appleby and William Buick at Newbury, beating Jolivette and race favourite Arapaho Gold.
body: The Godolphin colt had been second to the Michael Dods-trained Arapaho Gold in the Listed Rose Bowl Stakes over course and distance in July, after which Arapaho Gold came out to land the Gimcrack.
Nabati himself won at Newmarket, before most recently finishing third in the Flying Scotsman Stakes at Doncaster.
Given a patient ride by Buick, the 7-4 chance edged Jolivette by a short head, with Arapaho Gold another neck behind in third.
Jack Nicholls continued his fine association with Miss Yechance as the jockey landed the biggest race of his career to date in the Dubai International Airport World Trophy Stakes.

articles.title: Cardiff beat Charlton to record first win of the season
articles.summary: Cardiff's long wait for a first win on their Championship return is finally over after Republic of Ireland star Jack Moylan scored a brace in their 3-1 home victory over Charlton.
body: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Cardiff City and Charlton Athletic at the Cardiff City Stadium on Saturday; Jack Moylan double steers Bluebirds to a first victory of the campaign.

The Bluebirds had gone a record-equalling seven games without a win despite dominating a number of their previous matches, but they were full value for their triumph after taking a 2-0 lead in the opening quarter against a Charlton side that came into the fixture sitting in sixth place with only one league defeat.

Moylan scored the first goal in the eighth minute, teed up Yousef Salech for the second in the 24th and then thundered in his second, and Cardiff's third, in the 61st after Tyreece Campbell had reduced the deficit.

Charlton's physicality and pressing meant it took Cardiff some time to settle into their passing rhythm and the first chance of the game fell to Miles Leaburn after good work down the left flank from Karlan Grant and Campbell.

articles.title: West Ham fight back from two down to draw fiery derby at Millwall
articles.summary: West Ham battled back from 2-0 down to draw 2-2 at arch-rivals Millwall in a fiery renewal of one of football's most famous derbies, which included a late red card for Mohamadou Kante.
body: The half-time sub had helped change the game for the visitors, arrowing into the bottom corner from 25 yards to launch the comeback. The Hammers then levelled on 80 minutes when Konstantinos Mavropanos headed in at the back post and looked set to push on for a winner.

But Kante brought down Kyrell Lisbie with a last-man foul after he had been caught in possession to receive the fourth red card in the past seven meetings between these sides and Lyndon Dykes blasted over a last-gasp chance for the Millwall to clinch it.
It was a dramatic conclusion to a game which lived up to its billing, 14 years on from the last Dockers derby.
The home side overwhelmed West Ham in the first half. Close-range goals from Caleb Taylor and Camiel Neghli from Dykes long throws summed up their physical approach.
